about: Shared vectors for the wire format in docs/engine/WIRE.md. Engine/Tests/RowsTests/WireTests.swift and the Worker's tests check every case. Times are milliseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z, and days are Day indexes, the days since 1970-01-01. Every reader must refuse every bad case; its error is a fragment of the line the Swift reader refuses it with. A bad page given as text is the raw bytes, for a case that a parsed JSON value cannot hold. A receive row's mine says whether it counts as the person's: written by a replica a page named.
